name: Fractals at Close prices EA
summary: This EA trades based on Bill Williams' Fractal indicator applied to Close prices, entering long positions when price breaks above an up-fractal and short positions when price breaks below a down-fractal. It is a classic breakout system that uses fractal levels as dynamic support and resistance zones to generate trade signals. The EA automatically opens and manages positions when the close price confirms a fractal breakout.
summary_zh: 该EA基于比尔·威廉姆斯的分形指标应用于收盘价，当价格突破上分形时做多，突破下分形时做空。这是一个经典的突破系统，利用分形水平作为动态支撑和阻力区域来生成交易信号。EA在收盘价确认分形突破后自动开仓和管理仓位。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于比尔·威廉姆斯分形指标的突破交易。入场条件为：当收盘价向上突破最近的上分形时开多单，当收盘价向下突破最近的下分形时开空单。分形由至少5根K线组成，中间K线的最高价或最低价为极值，形成动态的支撑阻力位。出场条件通常依赖反向分形突破信号或固定的止损止盈设置。仓位管理方面，EA可能使用固定手数或基于资金的仓位计算方式。资金管理方面，该策略依赖分形结构的有效性，但分形突破在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的假突破信号，导致连续亏损。整体而言，这是一个结构化的突破跟踪系统，适合趋势明显的市场环境。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on breakout trading using Bill Williams' Fractal indicator. Entry conditions: a long position is opened when the close price breaks above the most recent up-fractal, and a short position is opened when the close price breaks below the most recent down-fractal. A fractal consists of at least 5 bars where the middle bar's high or low is the extreme, forming dynamic support and resistance levels. Exit conditions typically rely on an opposing fractal breakout signal or fixed stop-loss and take-profit settings. Position sizing may use fixed lots or account-balance-based calculation. Money management depends on the validity of the fractal structure, but fractal breakouts are prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses. Overall, this is a structured breakout-following system best suited for trending market conditions.

parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.name: FractalPeriod

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于区分订单
parameters.description_en: Order magic number to manage; 0 manages all orders

pros: 分形指标基于价格结构，不依赖滞后性参数，能较好地识别市场关键转折点
策略逻辑清晰简洁，入场规则明确，易于理解和验证
突破交易在趋势行情中表现良好，能够捕捉较大趋势波段
pros_en: The fractal indicator is based on price structure without lagging parameters, effectively identifying key market turning points
The strategy logic is clear and concise with well-defined entry rules, making it easy to understand and verify
Breakout trading performs well in trending markets, capable of capturing significant trend moves
cons: 在震荡行情中分形突破频繁产生假信号，导致连续止损和资金回撤
分形确认需要至少5根K线，信号存在天然滞后性，可能错过最佳入场时机
缺乏对市场状态（趋势/震荡）的过滤机制，所有行情统一处理
cons_en: Fractal breakouts frequently produce false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive stop-losses and drawdowns
Fractal confirmation requires at least 5 bars, introducing inherent lag that may cause missed optimal entry points
Lacks a market state filter (trending vs ranging), treating all market conditions uniformly
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或移动平均线），仅在趋势行情中交易分形突破，避免震荡市假信号
加入动态止损机制（如ATR止损或分形反向极值止损），提高风险调整比
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or moving average) to trade fractal breakouts only in trending conditions, avoiding false signals in ranging markets
Implement dynamic stop-loss mechanisms (e.g., ATR-based or fractal opposite extreme stop) to improve risk-adjusted returns

risk_points: 震荡行情中假突破导致频繁开仓止损，可能产生较大资金回撤
若未设置止损，单笔亏损可能无限扩大
risk_points_en: False breakouts in ranging markets cause frequent entries and stop-losses, potentially leading to significant drawdowns
Without stop-loss, a single losing trade can result in unlimited loss
